column1: # Lemma seed for the Nepali IME bundled dictionary.
# Aksharantar's Nepali split is mined from running text and contains
# mostly inflected forms (नेपालको, गरेको, थियो) — bare lemmas like
# नेपाल, छ, हो, मन, राम are absent or rare. This file backfills the
# build_dict.py overlays this file on top of the Aksharantar pairs:
# rows here win on collision and are guaranteed to ship in
# system_dict.tsv. Default frequency is 100000 (well above the
# Wikipedia top-frequency words ~38000) so seeded lemmas outrank
# Lines starting with # are comments. Multiple romanizations per
# Frequency column is optional — defaults to 100000.
# CONJUNCTS (commonly mistyped — Hindi-trained models often miss these)
